high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "agata.wendorff." The location mentioned in the post is Playa de Alcudia. The photo captures a serene beach scene with clear blue skies and a few scattered clouds. In the foreground, there is a woman standing on the sandy beach. She has long blonde hair and is wearing a white, open-back, crochet-style dress that reaches her knees. Her back is turned to the camera as she adjusts her hair with both hands. The beach is lined with tall palm trees, which cast shadows on the sand, indicating that it is likely midday or early
